visualCharacteristics: No hero variant exists; carousel-hero is a carousel (different base, multi-slide with CTA and dots). Static navy hero with an offset cover photo on the right, breadcrumb and H1. | Navy (#002755) band 569px tall; clock photo (1920x1080) absolutely positioned to the right/top as a cover image; breadcrumb (Home > Wake up to UK equities) top-left; large white H1 with an accent-coloured trailing dot. Visual tree records colored:true from the navy paint, but the section has a photo background, which belongs to the hero block, so the section is not colored.

contentPattern.description: Hero: clock photo, breadcrumb, H1 "Wake up to UK equities."

cells: Text: H1 "Wake up to UK equities." (trailing dot is styling, not authored)

structure.notes: Breadcrumb (Home > Wake up to UK equities) is navigation, not authored content; generate it from the page hierarchy rather than authoring it in the hero.

usage.description: Static page hero: navy band with a cover photo offset to the right/top, generated breadcrumb (Home > page title) and a large white H1 whose trailing full stop is rendered in the brand accent. Row 1: image | Row 2: H1 (dot optional, added automatically). Breadcrumb home defaults to the /<country>/<lang>/<audience>/ root; override with page metadata breadcrumb-home.

reuseGuidance: Use for single, non-rotating landing-page heroes. For multi-slide heroes with CTAs use carousel-hero.
